text: {"memo": "THE BOEING COMPANY (BA) posted mixed results as of 2025‑03‑31. In FY2024, Boeing generated $66.5\u202fbillion in revenue, recorded a net loss of $11.8\u202fbillion, operating income of $‑10.7\u202fbillion, diluted EPS of $‑18.36, and operating cash flow of $‑12.1\u202fbillion. Compared with FY2023, revenue fell to $77.8\u202fbillion, net loss widened to $2.22\u202fbillion, operating income improved to $‑0.77\u202fbillion, diluted EPS to $‑3.67, and operating cash flow turned negative at $5.96\u202fbillion. The sharp decline in cash generation and the deepening loss in FY2024 highlight ongoing pressure from production delays and cost overruns. However, the improvement in operating income from a larger loss in FY2023 suggests some stabilization in core operations. The company’s cash burn and negative earnings continue to weigh on valuation, but the modest improvement in operating cash flow indicates a potential bottoming of cash outflows. One‑line view: BA remains a high‑risk, cash‑negative play pending a turnaround in earnings and cash flow."}
